title: Nutrition — soft relief, four fills
question: The soft channels you liked, with the toy-like raised pill replaced. Four ways to fill them. Pick one to build, or steer.

options.label: Flat colour
options.thesis: Matte colour lying flush in the recess, a straight edge at the level.
options.viewport: Same card, the fill printed inside the channel.
options.risk: Simplest; relies on the channel for all the depth.

options.label: Fine line
options.thesis: A slim stripe rising in the channel to a small round dot, like an instrument's needle.
options.viewport: Same card, four thin lines with dots at the level.
options.risk: The lightest; less colour on screen, so less at a glance.

options.label: Colour wash
options.thesis: Soft tinted light pooled in the channel, strongest at the bottom, a crisp line at the level.
options.viewport: Same card, gradient fills with a thin top line.
options.risk: The fill is faint near the top; the level line has to carry it.

options.label: Level meter
options.thesis: Small rounded segments stacked up to the level, the rest left as faint recesses.
options.risk: Segments round the value to a step; the exact number stays below.
